race.comment: NORTHERN ALLIANCE (3) North Pacific gelding on debut for the Bjorn Baker yard. Brings a strong first-starter profile and has produced two Warwick Farm trials to have him ready, the latest a solid third. He lacks race experience but meets a maiden without much depth and profiles as the one with the most upside. CAPDIVA (4) is race-fit and worked home from well back when fourth at Nowra, with her wide run at Newcastle two starts ago giving some context to that sixth. The 1000m remains the question, though three placings around the distance keep her in the minor mix. PRIZING (6) resumes from a ten-month break and now in the new stable. Trialled at Dubbo and gets a 1.5kg claim, so she has more upside than her plain Cranbourne debut suggests last December. CLEANSING AURA (7) is a Headwater filly from a Lonhro mare on debut for the Clint Lundholm yard. Starts her career off a Dubbo trial win over 860m. Must be kept safe.
